Maldives
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi, India.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO up to 30 days
Regular biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Service/Official biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Diplomatic biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Citizens of the Republic of Maldives are required visas when entering, exiting

links.text: the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi, India.
